27 days to go: Rio New Year's Eve costs R$ 0 on the sand 🎆
🏖️ Copacabana beach party on Dec 31: free
🎤 Main stage from 6 pm, 13 stages across the city
🎆 Fireworks at midnight from 19 barges: 12 minutes
🚇 Metro: last year's round-trip pass was R$ 15 (≈ US$ 2.70), online only. 2026/27 details in December
🎶 Bonus: free Christmas samba show on Dec 26
🤍 Wear white, carry little, pick a meeting point
